page.overview:
Who is Billy Ocean?

When Kirk and Luann Van Houten get lost in the sea, Milhouse stayed with the Simpson family. The next day, Homer wanted to cheer Milhouse up, so he offered him a Billy Ocean CD. However, Homer noticed that there is the word "Ocean" on the cover, so he tried to find another thing not to remind Milhouse's parents' doom to Milhouse.
